artifact: B2b slice 2 (chromap scATAC FASTQ->fragments) real-data validation
summary: End-to-end validation of the scATAC raw-FASTQ entry point (chromatin_scatac_align.py, chromap) using real ATAC sequencing reads from GEO, and confirmation of the full chain FASTQ -> chromap -> fragments -> snapatac2 bridge -> cell x peak matrix. Surfaced and documents a real, systematic GEO/SRA limitation: SRA does not preserve the 10x scATAC 16 bp cell-barcode read.

sra_barcode_finding.observation: Across 13 GEO 10x scATAC/multiome accessions probed via the NCBI SRA trace API (no download), NONE preserve the 10x scATAC 16 bp cell-barcode read as a recoverable read. Runs are nreads=2 (two genomic mates only) or carry a 28 bp read that is a 10x GEX cell-barcode+UMI (scRNA), not the standalone 16 bp scATAC barcode.
sra_barcode_finding.implication: This is a documented SRA normalization behavior for 10x scATAC, not an ARIA bug. It empirically VALIDATES slice 2's honest-skip design: chromatin_scatac_align requires an explicit barcode_fastq + whitelist because the barcode read cannot be inferred from the genomic FASTQs and is frequently absent from SRA. To run scATAC FASTQ->fragments, the original 10x barcode read must come from a source that preserves it (e.g. a GEO supplementary RAW fastq tar, or the original 10x deliverable).

real_inputs_from_geo.genomic_reads: GSE162690 SRR13199777 (real 10x scATAC ATAC reads, 1,010,413 paired genomic reads, 33 bp) downloaded via prefetch + fasterq-dump
real_inputs_from_geo.barcode_whitelist: real 10x ATAC whitelist 737K-cratac-v1 (737,280 x 16 bp barcodes)

validation.assigned_not_real: The barcode<->read assignment (800 cell barcodes drawn from the real whitelist, assigned across the real genomic reads) is synthesized BECAUSE SRA did not preserve the real per-read barcodes. Genomic sequences, aligner, whitelist, and the full pipeline are real; only the cell identity of each read is assigned.
validation.scope: This validates the slice 2 CODE path end-to-end (chromap index build, alignment of real genomic reads, whitelist barcode correction, fragment generation, bgzip+tabix, handoff to the bridge). It is NOT a biological validation of cell clustering (cells are assigned, and the run is chr20-only).

downstream_bridge.note: min_fragments lowered to 5 for plumbing confirmation; low peak count expected (chr20-only, dispersed cell-line genomic reads, assigned barcodes)

results.chain: FASTQ (real GEO genomic reads) -> chromap -> fragments.tsv.gz (real) -> snapatac2 bridge -> cell x peak matrix

provenance.note: Genomic reads + whitelist are real; cell-barcode assignment is synthesized because SRA does not preserve the 10x scATAC barcode read (see sra_barcode_finding).
